hardness_axes.name: Discover
hardness_axes.reasoning: Solver must learn from runtime probes and dual-language sources that load MW updates and topology edge dumps can look correct while the availability bitmap remains keyed to a stale topology generation — none of that coupling is stated in instruction.md.

hardness_axes.name: Synthesize
hardness_axes.reasoning: Correctness spans a Rust ledger apply/cursor path, a Go adjacency cascade into the availability bitmap, and a Go probe seal that must consume the post-invalidation view; no single crate or package owns the full contract.

hardness_axes.name: Diagnose

hardness_axes.name: Navigate coupling
hardness_axes.reasoning: Advancing the ledger cursor before publishing invalidation makes a second replay a no-op; cascading only the feeder node leaves child circuits green; using the MW-threshold probe path passes shallow totals but fails cascade and idempotence tests.

hardness_axes.name: Reason beyond training

discovery_budget.discovery: Availability bitmap entries are keyed by topology generation; replay updates load-state and advances the ledger cursor but leaves the generation pin unchanged, so the Go inspector keeps serving pre-shed bits.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming the generation pin tells the agent to bump one integer and skip cascade/probe reasoning.

discovery_budget.discovery: Feeder-level shed must cascade through adjacency to descendant circuits; writing only the feeder node into the bitmap leaves circuit-level probes green while feeder MW totals look correct.
discovery_budget.planned_location: environment/topo/internal/walk/walk_r4.go and fixture adjacency under environment/data/topo/
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Stating 'walk children' collapses the hard coupling into a single graph recipe.

discovery_budget.discovery: The Go probe exposes an MW-threshold fast path that ignores the bitmap; using it can pass shallow load-total checks but fails multi-circuit cascade and second-pass idempotence.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Warning agents off the fast path removes the primary false-confidence trap.

discovery_budget.discovery: Invalidation must be published before the ledger cursor advances; otherwise a second replay is a no-op that never rebuilds availability.
discovery_budget.planned_location: environment/ledger/src/apply.rs barrier ordering relative to environment/topo/internal/seal/seal_n2.go
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Revealing cursor-after-invalidate ordering turns the task into a transcribed sequence.
